heading: Xi Jinping to visit US from Sept 23 to 25: What to expect? Tariffs, Iran war, trade truce — 6 points
author: LiveMint Editorial
paragraphs: Chinese President Xi Jinping will have an “in-depth exchange of views” with US President Trump “on major issues concerning bilateral ties and world peace and development,” a spokesperson said, as China announced a schedule for Xi's state visit to the US.
